speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash along with numbness and tingling in your palms. To understand what is happening, how long have you noticed these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

Based on your description of a one-year itchy rash on the upper body and face, combined with numbness and tingling in your palms while working in a rice farm and caring for livestock, these symptoms are highly suggestive of a parasitic infestation. Before confirming this, I need to know if anyone else in your household or workplace is experiencing similar itching or skin issues.
